instruction: Hãy diễn giải câu truy vấn SQL dưới đây bằng tiếng Việt:
input:
Schema cơ sở dữ liệu PostgreSQL (database: do_an).

companies(
  id PK, short_name, company_name, email, license_number, website, phone, address,
  representative, category, created_at, license_date)

officers(
  id PK, position, hire_date, department, phone, created_at, email, full_name)

currencies(
  code PK, name, exchange_rate_to_vnd, updated_at)

supply_contracts(
  id PK, company_id FK->companies.id, officer_id FK->officers.id, created_at,
  document_date, status, valid_from, valid_to, document_number, receiving_country,
  partner_company_address, partner_representative, partner_company_name)

recruitment_orders(
  id PK, contract_id FK->supply_contracts.id, total_quantity, skilled_quantity,
  gender_requirement, female_quantity, job_industry, created_at, safety_policy,
  job_title, contract_duration, age_requirement, deductions, working_hours,
  allowance_and_bonus, insurance_policy, accommodation_policy, recruitment_period,
  work_location, rest_hours)

order_financials(
  order_id PK FK->recruitment_orders.id, currency_code FK->currencies.code,
  partner_training_fee, worker_passport_fee, partner_visa_medical_fee,
  partner_service_fee, worker_training_fee, partner_airfare_policy,
  total_worker_cost, base_salary, worker_service_fee, created_at,
  worker_visa_medical_fee, base_salary_usd)

workers(
  id PK, assigned_order_id FK->recruitment_orders.id, id_card_number, status,
  phone, gender, date_of_birth, full_name, created_at, hometown)

contract_approvals(
  id PK, officer_id FK->officers.id, contract_id FK->supply_contracts.id,
  created_at, decision_type, reason_description, decision_date)

Quan hệ chính:
- companies (1) - (n) supply_contracts, qua supply_contracts.company_id
- officers (1) - (n) supply_contracts (quản lý hợp đồng), qua supply_contracts.officer_id
- supply_contracts (1) - (n) recruitment_orders, qua recruitment_orders.contract_id
- recruitment_orders (1) - (1) order_financials, qua order_financials.order_id
- recruitment_orders (1) - (n) workers (lao động được gán), qua workers.assigned_order_id
- currencies (1) - (n) order_financials, qua order_financials.currency_code
- supply_contracts (1) - (n) contract_approvals, qua contract_approvals.contract_id
- officers (1) - (n) contract_approvals (người quyết định), qua contract_approvals.officer_id

SQL cần giải thích:
SELECT c.company_name, SUM(of.total_worker_cost) AS tong_chi_phi FROM companies c JOIN supply_contracts sc ON sc.company_id = c.id JOIN recruitment_orders ro ON ro.contract_id = sc.id JOIN order_financials of ON of.order_id = ro.id GROUP BY c.company_name ORDER BY tong_chi_phi DESC LIMIT 5;
output: Câu truy vấn này kết hợp 4 bảng thông qua 3 lượt JOIN theo khóa ngoại. Kết quả được gom nhóm theo một hoặc nhiều cột trước khi tính giá trị tổng hợp. Hàm SUM cộng dồn giá trị số của cột liên quan. Dữ liệu được sắp xếp theo một tiêu chí cụ thể trước khi hiển thị. Câu lệnh giới hạn số dòng trả về để chỉ hiện phần dữ liệu quan trọng nhất.

  document_date, status, valid_from, valid_to, document_number, receiving_country,
  partner_company_address, partner_representative, partner_company_name)

  partner_service_fee, worker_training_fee, partner_airfare_policy,
  total_worker_cost, base_salary, worker_service_fee, created_at,
  worker_visa_medical_fee, base_salary_usd)

workers(

  phone, gender, date_of_birth, full_name, created_at, hometown)

contract_approvals(
  id PK, officer_id FK->officers.id, contract_id FK->supply_contracts.id,
  created_at, decision_type, reason_description, decision_date)

- currencies (1) - (n) order_financials, qua order_financials.currency_code

Schema cơ sở dữ liệu PostgreSQL (database: do_an).

companies(
  id PK, short_name, company_name, email, license_number, website, phone, address,
  representative, category, created_at, license_date)

officers(
  id PK, position, hire_date, department, phone, created_at, email, full_name)

currencies(
  code PK, name, exchange_rate_to_vnd, updated_at)

supply_contracts(
  id PK, company_id FK->companies.id, officer_id FK->officers.id, created_at,
  document_date, status, valid_from, valid_to, document_number, receiving_country,
  partner_company_address, partner_representative, partner_company_name)

recruitment_orders(
  id PK, contract_id FK->supply_contracts.id, total_quantity, skilled_quantity,
  gender_requirement, female_quantity, job_industry, created_at, safety_policy,
  job_title, contract_duration, age_requirement, deductions, working_hours,
  allowance_and_bonus, insurance_policy, accommodation_policy, recruitment_period,
  work_location, rest_hours)

order_financials(
  order_id PK FK->recruitment_orders.id, currency_code FK->currencies.code,
  partner_training_fee, worker_passport_fee, partner_visa_medical_fee,
  partner_service_fee, worker_training_fee, partner_airfare_policy,
  total_worker_cost, base_salary, worker_service_fee, created_at,
  worker_visa_medical_fee, base_salary_usd)

workers(
  id PK, assigned_order_id FK->recruitment_orders.id, id_card_number, status,
  phone, gender, date_of_birth, full_name, created_at, hometown)

contract_approvals(
  id PK, officer_id FK->officers.id, contract_id FK->supply_contracts.id,
  created_at, decision_type, reason_description, decision_date)

Quan hệ chính:
- companies (1) - (n) supply_contracts, qua supply_contracts.company_id
- officers (1) - (n) supply_contracts (quản lý hợp đồng), qua supply_contracts.officer_id
- supply_contracts (1) - (n) recruitment_orders, qua recruitment_orders.contract_id
- recruitment_orders (1) - (1) order_financials, qua order_financials.order_id
- recruitment_orders (1) - (n) workers (lao động được gán), qua workers.assigned_order_id
- currencies (1) - (n) order_financials, qua order_financials.currency_code
- supply_contracts (1) - (n) contract_approvals, qua contract_approvals.contract_id
- officers (1) - (n) contract_approvals (người quyết định), qua contract_approvals.officer_id

SQL cần giải thích:
SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM document_date) AS nam, COUNT(*) AS so_hop_dong FROM supply_contracts GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM document_date) ORDER BY nam;
output: Dữ liệu được nhóm lại để tính toán tổng hợp cho từng nhóm. Hàm COUNT dùng để đếm số dòng tương ứng. Dữ liệu được sắp xếp theo một tiêu chí cụ thể trước khi hiển thị.

  representative, category, created_at, license_date)

officers(
  id PK, position, hire_date, department, phone, created_at, email, full_name)

currencies(
  code PK, name, exchange_rate_to_vnd, updated_at)

supply_contracts(
  id PK, company_id FK->companies.id, officer_id FK->officers.id, created_at,

  partner_company_address, partner_representative, partner_company_name)

recruitment_orders(

  gender_requirement, female_quantity, job_industry, created_at, safety_policy,

  allowance_and_bonus, insurance_policy, accommodation_policy, recruitment_period,
  work_location, rest_hours)

  partner_training_fee, worker_passport_fee, partner_visa_medical_fee,
  partner_service_fee, worker_training_fee, partner_airfare_policy,
  total_worker_cost, base_salary, worker_service_fee, created_at,
  worker_visa_medical_fee, base_salary_usd)

workers(

  phone, gender, date_of_birth, full_name, created_at, hometown)

contract_approvals(
  id PK, officer_id FK->officers.id, contract_id FK->supply_contracts.id,
  created_at, decision_type, reason_description, decision_date)

- officers (1) - (n) supply_contracts (quản lý hợp đồng), qua supply_contracts.officer_id

- currencies (1) - (n) order_financials, qua order_financials.currency_code
- supply_contracts (1) - (n) contract_approvals, qua contract_approvals.contract_id
- officers (1) - (n) contract_approvals (người quyết định), qua contract_approvals.officer_id

order_financials(

  id PK, officer_id FK->officers.id, contract_id FK->supply_contracts.id,
  created_at, decision_type, reason_description, decision_date)

Quan hệ chính:
- companies (1) - (n) supply_contracts, qua supply_contracts.company_id
- officers (1) - (n) supply_contracts (quản lý hợp đồng), qua supply_contracts.officer_id
- supply_contracts (1) - (n) recruitment_orders, qua recruitment_orders.contract_id
- recruitment_orders (1) - (1) order_financials, qua order_financials.order_id
- recruitment_orders (1) - (n) workers (lao động được gán), qua workers.assigned_order_id
- currencies (1) - (n) order_financials, qua order_financials.currency_code

- officers (1) - (n) contract_approvals (người quyết định), qua contract_approvals.officer_id

SQL cần giải thích:
WITH thong_ke AS (SELECT c.company_name, COUNT(ro.id) AS so_don, SUM(ro.total_quantity) AS tong_lao_dong FROM companies c JOIN supply_contracts sc ON sc.company_id = c.id JOIN recruitment_orders ro ON ro.contract_id = sc.id GROUP BY c.company_name) SELECT * FROM thong_ke ORDER BY so_don DESC LIMIT 3;

Hàm SUM cộng dồn giá trị số của cột liên quan. Common Table Expression (CTE) được dùng để tính toán trung gian trước khi truy vấn chính sử dụng lại kết quả đó. Kết quả được sắp xếp để dễ theo dõi thứ tự quan trọng nhất. Câu lệnh giới hạn số dòng trả về để chỉ hiện phần dữ liệu quan trọng nhất.

  id PK, short_name, company_name, email, license_number, website, phone, address,
  representative, category, created_at, license_date)

officers(
  id PK, position, hire_date, department, phone, created_at, email, full_name)

currencies(
  code PK, name, exchange_rate_to_vnd, updated_at)

supply_contracts(
  id PK, company_id FK->companies.id, officer_id FK->officers.id, created_at,
  document_date, status, valid_from, valid_to, document_number, receiving_country,
  partner_company_address, partner_representative, partner_company_name)

recruitment_orders(
  id PK, contract_id FK->supply_contracts.id, total_quantity, skilled_quantity,
  gender_requirement, female_quantity, job_industry, created_at, safety_policy,
  job_title, contract_duration, age_requirement, deductions, working_hours,
  allowance_and_bonus, insurance_policy, accommodation_policy, recruitment_period,
  work_location, rest_hours)

order_financials(
  order_id PK FK->recruitment_orders.id, currency_code FK->currencies.code,
  partner_training_fee, worker_passport_fee, partner_visa_medical_fee,
  partner_service_fee, worker_training_fee, partner_airfare_policy,
  total_worker_cost, base_salary, worker_service_fee, created_at,
  worker_visa_medical_fee, base_salary_usd)

workers(
  id PK, assigned_order_id FK->recruitment_orders.id, id_card_number, status,
  phone, gender, date_of_birth, full_name, created_at, hometown)

contract_approvals(
  id PK, officer_id FK->officers.id, contract_id FK->supply_contracts.id,
  created_at, decision_type, reason_description, decision_date)

- supply_contracts (1) - (n) contract_approvals, qua contract_approvals.contract_id

- recruitment_orders (1) - (1) order_financials, qua order_financials.order_id

SELECT c.company_name, AVG(of.base_salary_usd) AS luong_tb_usd FROM companies c JOIN supply_contracts sc ON sc.company_id = c.id JOIN recruitment_orders ro ON ro.contract_id = sc.id JOIN order_financials of ON of.order_id = ro.id GROUP BY c.company_name ORDER BY luong_tb_usd DESC;

PARTITION BY chia dữ liệu thành từng nhóm riêng để hàm window tính toán độc lập trong mỗi nhóm. Dữ liệu được sắp xếp theo một tiêu chí cụ thể trước khi hiển thị.

Schema cơ sở dữ liệu PostgreSQL (database: do_an).

companies(
  id PK, short_name, company_name, email, license_number, website, phone, address,
  representative, category, created_at, license_date)

officers(
  id PK, position, hire_date, department, phone, created_at, email, full_name)

currencies(
  code PK, name, exchange_rate_to_vnd, updated_at)

supply_contracts(
  id PK, company_id FK->companies.id, officer_id FK->officers.id, created_at,
  document_date, status, valid_from, valid_to, document_number, receiving_country,
  partner_company_address, partner_representative, partner_company_name)

recruitment_orders(
  id PK, contract_id FK->supply_contracts.id, total_quantity, skilled_quantity,
  gender_requirement, female_quantity, job_industry, created_at, safety_policy,
  job_title, contract_duration, age_requirement, deductions, working_hours,
  allowance_and_bonus, insurance_policy, accommodation_policy, recruitment_period,
  work_location, rest_hours)

order_financials(
  order_id PK FK->recruitment_orders.id, currency_code FK->currencies.code,
  partner_training_fee, worker_passport_fee, partner_visa_medical_fee,
  partner_service_fee, worker_training_fee, partner_airfare_policy,
  total_worker_cost, base_salary, worker_service_fee, created_at,
  worker_visa_medical_fee, base_salary_usd)

workers(
  id PK, assigned_order_id FK->recruitment_orders.id, id_card_number, status,
  phone, gender, date_of_birth, full_name, created_at, hometown)

contract_approvals(
  id PK, officer_id FK->officers.id, contract_id FK->supply_contracts.id,
  created_at, decision_type, reason_description, decision_date)

Quan hệ chính:
- companies (1) - (n) supply_contracts, qua supply_contracts.company_id
- officers (1) - (n) supply_contracts (quản lý hợp đồng), qua supply_contracts.officer_id
- supply_contracts (1) - (n) recruitment_orders, qua recruitment_orders.contract_id
- recruitment_orders (1) - (1) order_financials, qua order_financials.order_id
- recruitment_orders (1) - (n) workers (lao động được gán), qua workers.assigned_order_id
- currencies (1) - (n) order_financials, qua order_financials.currency_code
- supply_contracts (1) - (n) contract_approvals, qua contract_approvals.contract_id
- officers (1) - (n) contract_approvals (người quyết định), qua contract_approvals.officer_id
output: SELECT ca.decision_type, sc.document_number FROM contract_approvals ca JOIN supply_contracts sc ON ca.contract_id = sc.id;

- companies (1) - (n) supply_contracts, qua supply_contracts.company_id

- recruitment_orders (1) - (1) order_financials, qua order_financials.order_id

  id PK, short_name, company_name, email, license_number, website, phone, address,
  representative, category, created_at, license_date)

officers(
  id PK, position, hire_date, department, phone, created_at, email, full_name)

currencies(
  code PK, name, exchange_rate_to_vnd, updated_at)

supply_contracts(
  id PK, company_id FK->companies.id, officer_id FK->officers.id, created_at,
  document_date, status, valid_from, valid_to, document_number, receiving_country,
  partner_company_address, partner_representative, partner_company_name)

recruitment_orders(
  id PK, contract_id FK->supply_contracts.id, total_quantity, skilled_quantity,
  gender_requirement, female_quantity, job_industry, created_at, safety_policy,
  job_title, contract_duration, age_requirement, deductions, working_hours,
  allowance_and_bonus, insurance_policy, accommodation_policy, recruitment_period,
  work_location, rest_hours)

order_financials(
  order_id PK FK->recruitment_orders.id, currency_code FK->currencies.code,
  partner_training_fee, worker_passport_fee, partner_visa_medical_fee,
  partner_service_fee, worker_training_fee, partner_airfare_policy,
  total_worker_cost, base_salary, worker_service_fee, created_at,
  worker_visa_medical_fee, base_salary_usd)

workers(
  id PK, assigned_order_id FK->recruitment_orders.id, id_card_number, status,
  phone, gender, date_of_birth, full_name, created_at, hometown)

contract_approvals(
  id PK, officer_id FK->officers.id, contract_id FK->supply_contracts.id,
  created_at, decision_type, reason_description, decision_date)

Quan hệ chính:
- companies (1) - (n) supply_contracts, qua supply_contracts.company_id
- officers (1) - (n) supply_contracts (quản lý hợp đồng), qua supply_contracts.officer_id
- supply_contracts (1) - (n) recruitment_orders, qua recruitment_orders.contract_id
- recruitment_orders (1) - (1) order_financials, qua order_financials.order_id
- recruitment_orders (1) - (n) workers (lao động được gán), qua workers.assigned_order_id
- currencies (1) - (n) order_financials, qua order_financials.currency_code
- supply_contracts (1) - (n) contract_approvals, qua contract_approvals.contract_id
- officers (1) - (n) contract_approvals (người quyết định), qua contract_approvals.officer_id
output: SELECT c.company_name, SUM(ro.total_quantity) AS tong FROM companies c JOIN supply_contracts sc ON sc.company_id = c.id JOIN recruitment_orders ro ON ro.contract_id = sc.id GROUP BY c.company_name HAVING SUM(ro.total_quantity) > (SELECT AVG(total_quantity) FROM recruitment_orders);

Quan hệ chính:
- companies (1) - (n) supply_contracts, qua supply_contracts.company_id

- recruitment_orders (1) - (1) order_financials, qua order_financials.order_id

SQL cần giải thích:
WITH chi_phi_nam AS (SELECT c.company_name, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM sc.document_date) AS nam, SUM(of.total_worker_cost) AS tong_chi_phi, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM sc.document_date) ORDER BY SUM(of.total_worker_cost) DESC) AS hang FROM companies c JOIN supply_contracts sc ON sc.company_id = c.id JOIN recruitment_orders ro ON ro.contract_id = sc.id JOIN order_financials of ON of.order_id = ro.id GROUP BY c.company_name, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM sc.document_date)) SELECT * FROM chi_phi_nam WHERE hang = 1;

Hàm SUM cộng dồn giá trị số của cột liên quan. Window function RANK() xếp hạng các dòng mà vẫn giữ lại toàn bộ kết quả, khác với dùng LIMIT. Common Table Expression (CTE) được dùng để tính toán trung gian trước khi truy vấn chính sử dụng lại kết quả đó. PARTITION BY chia dữ liệu thành từng nhóm riêng để hàm window tính toán độc lập trong mỗi nhóm. Dữ liệu được sắp xếp theo một tiêu chí cụ thể trước khi hiển thị.

  id PK, assigned_order_id FK->recruitment_orders.id, id_card_number, status,
  phone, gender, date_of_birth, full_name, created_at, hometown)

contract_approvals(
  id PK, officer_id FK->officers.id, contract_id FK->supply_contracts.id,
  created_at, decision_type, reason_description, decision_date)

Quan hệ chính:
- companies (1) - (n) supply_contracts, qua supply_contracts.company_id
- officers (1) - (n) supply_contracts (quản lý hợp đồng), qua supply_contracts.officer_id
- supply_contracts (1) - (n) recruitment_orders, qua recruitment_orders.contract_id
- recruitment_orders (1) - (1) order_financials, qua order_financials.order_id
- recruitment_orders (1) - (n) workers (lao động được gán), qua workers.assigned_order_id
- currencies (1) - (n) order_financials, qua order_financials.currency_code
- supply_contracts (1) - (n) contract_approvals, qua contract_approvals.contract_id
- officers (1) - (n) contract_approvals (người quyết định), qua contract_approvals.officer_id
output: SELECT ca.decision_type, sc.document_number FROM contract_approvals ca JOIN supply_contracts sc ON ca.contract_id = sc.id;
